hypotheses.storyTitle: Apply Statement Credit for Bill Reduction
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Customer checks current coin balance and cashback to allocate rewards directly to statement credit.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer visits mobile app to review rewards standing and current goal progress.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring transparent coin-to-cash conversion rates without encountering irrelevant vouchers or gamification.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Direct, frictionless application of accumulated rewards as a statement credit on the linked card.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Effortless tracking and application of statement credits for bill reduction.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Customer tracks progress toward the holiday spending goal with predictable reward allocations.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer reviews active goal status to ensure automatic payment rewards are contributing correctly.
hypotheses.storyTension: Verifying that reward accumulation aligns with the target value without unexpected delays or opaque rules.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear view of goal milestones and tangible value breakdown supporting financial objectives.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Transparent rewards tracking and goal progress clarity.
